title: Strategic Plan | UC Berkeley
text_preview: Strategic Plan | UC Berkeley Skip to Content Berkeley’s Strategic Plan Illuminating our path forward We stand at a pivotal moment. New technologies, shifting economics, and growing global pressures are forcing universities to rethink how they work — and how they contribute to solving society’s most pressing challenges. Berkeley has a real chance to shape what comes next, not just respond to it. Our strategic plan starts with what we care about the most: students who thrive and leave ready to do meaningful work, faculty who are pushing the edges of human knowledge, research that tackles society’s greatest challenges and staff who are proud to work for a mission-driven institution.
